items.passage: Transcript: Good afternoon, this is Henrik Castellanos with details for Saturday's geology trip to Ashcombe Quarry. Usually our field-trip buses leave from the front steps of Orrin Pavilion at 7:00 a.m. This time the quarry has given first-year students an early slot, so first-years will leave from the loading dock behind the pavilion at 6:30. The third-year mapping group leaves from the west car park at 8:15. The quarry also requires hard hats and steel-toed boots on the lower benches. We'll lend hard hats, so collect one from Room 364 on Friday afternoon. We don't have boots to lend, and please don't go out and buy a pair for one day. If you don't own any, come anyway: you'll spend the morning on the upper viewing platform, where boots aren't needed, and join everyone at the riverbank site after lunch. Nobody needs to do the written alternative assignment this year.
